symptoms.title: Yellowing leaf margins
symptoms.description: Yellowing of older leaves, usually beginning along the leaf margins and progressing toward the midrib.

symptoms.title: Progressive yellowing
symptoms.description: Yellowing and chlorosis progressively spread from older leaves toward younger leaves.

symptoms.title: Wilting and collapsed leaves
symptoms.description: Affected leaves wilt and collapse at the petiole, causing them to hang around the pseudostem.

symptoms.title: Splitting pseudostem
symptoms.description: The plant may develop longitudinal splitting at the base of the pseudostem.

symptoms.title: Reduced leaf development
symptoms.description: Leaves may become poorly developed or malformed, with normal leaf production eventually declining.

symptoms.title: Severe wilting and plant death
symptoms.description: In severe cases, progressive leaf necrosis, wilting, and plant death occur.

treatment.title: Prioritize prevention and containment
treatment.description: Emphasize prevention and containment because Fusarium wilt is difficult to manage once established.

treatment.title: Plan for resistant or tolerant cultivars
treatment.description: Use resistant or tolerant banana cultivars as an important long-term management strategy.

treatment.title: Manage severely infected plants only where recommended
treatment.description: Remove and appropriately manage severely infected plants where recommended to limit sources of pathogen spread.

treatment.title: Establish plants from disease-free material
treatment.description: Use healthy and disease-free planting materials when establishing or replacing banana plants.

treatment.title: Maintain sanitation and biosecurity
treatment.description: Maintain appropriate sanitation and farm biosecurity practices.

treatment.title: Monitor affected fields
treatment.description: Monitor affected fields and plants for additional symptoms and disease spread.

treatment.title: Do not rely on a generic fungicide treatment
treatment.description: Avoid treating Panama Disease as a condition that can be resolved through a generic fungicide recommendation.

treatment.title: Integrate management measures
treatment.description: Integrate resistant planting materials, sanitation, disease monitoring, and other appropriate management measures rather than depending on a single intervention.

prevention.title: Use disease-free planting material
prevention.description: Use healthy and disease-free planting materials.

prevention.title: Prevent contaminated soil movement
prevention.description: Prevent the movement of contaminated soil between production areas.

prevention.title: Keep suspect planting material out
prevention.description: Avoid introducing potentially contaminated planting materials into disease-free areas.

prevention.title: Keep equipment and tools clean
prevention.description: Maintain clean farm equipment and tools.

prevention.title: Limit contaminated soil and water movement
prevention.description: Limit the movement of potentially contaminated soil and water.

prevention.title: Monitor for Fusarium wilt
prevention.description: Regularly monitor banana plants for symptoms of Fusarium wilt.

prevention.title: Use suitable resistant or tolerant cultivars
prevention.description: Use resistant or tolerant cultivars where suitable.

prevention.title: Integrate biosecurity and disease management
prevention.description: Apply integrated disease-management and biosecurity practices to reduce pathogen establishment and dissemination.
